name: 10xengineer-eda
displayName: 10xEngineers EDA: Verilog, SystemVerilog & UVM Verification Suite
description: All-in-one Verilog, SystemVerilog and UVM design-verification suite. Install Docker and press Run: the open-source tools (Icarus, Verilator with UVM, Yosys, cocotb) download by themselves, no simulator or license needed. Generates SV, UVM and cocotb testbenches from your RTL, runs regressions (Questa and VCS too), and adds a waveform viewer with decoders and X-trace, coverage, Excel test plans, formal, synthesis and sign-off. One extension instead of ten.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Viewing works everywhere; generating files and running simulators requires a trusted workspace. Settings that name programs or container images are read from your user settings only.

command.description: dvflow command; regress writes runs/<id>/results.json + results.ndjson which the 10xEngineer RTL Regression Explorer reads

walkthroughs.title: 10xEngineers EDA: from one RTL file to a verified design
walkthroughs.description: Take a single Verilog/SystemVerilog file to a self-checking testbench, UVM, a regression dashboard and a testbench-quality score. No simulator install needed.

steps.title: Try the demo (5 minutes)
steps.description:
Creates a ready-made project (a 4-bit adder with SV, UVM and cocotb testbenches) and opens a Demo Tour: one button per feature, each explaining what it does and why it matters.
[Create Demo Project](command:tenxDebug.demo.create)

steps.title: Set up the open-source tools
steps.description:
Icarus, Verilator (with UVM), Yosys, SymbiYosys and cocotb run from a Docker image, so you install only Docker.
[Set Up Open-Source Toolchain](command:tenxDebug.toolchain.setup)

steps.title: Select your DUT
steps.description:
Open your RTL file, then pick the top module and the template that matches what it does (the suggested one is first).
[DV: Select DUT](command:tenxDebug.dv.selectDut)

steps.title: Generate the testbenches
steps.description:
One click creates a self-checking SystemVerilog testbench, a full UVM environment and a test plan with requirements.
[DV: Generate Testbench](command:tenxDebug.dv.generateTestbench)

steps.title: Run a regression
steps.description:
Pick the simulator (Icarus, Verilator, Questa, VCS), the suite and the seeds. Turn on code coverage to see what the tests never exercise.
[DV: Run Regression](command:tenxDebug.dv.runRegression)

steps.title: Explore the dashboard
steps.description:
Click any run for its log and waveform, compare runs in History, check traceability, and press Ctrl+K to search.
[DV: Open Dashboard](command:tenxDebug.dv.openDashboard)

steps.title: See and run the UVM testbench
steps.description:
View the generated UVM architecture, then run the UVM tests on Verilator with no license.
[UVM: Show Architecture Diagram](command:tenxDebug.uvmArchitecture)

steps.title: Synthesize, gate-level simulate and prove
steps.description:
Synthesis (latches, logic depth), logic equivalence, gate-level simulation of your testbench on the netlist, and a formal proof that the DUT matches the spec for every input. All open-source, in one click.
[DV: Sign-off Check](command:tenxDebug.dv.signoff)

steps.title: Measure testbench quality
steps.description:
Passing tests don't prove the testbench would catch a bug. Mutation testing plants small bugs in copies of the DUT and reports which ones the tests miss.
[DV: Mutation Test](command:tenxDebug.dv.mutate)

tenxDebug.lint.tool.description: Linter / semantic checker for Verilog/SystemVerilog. 'auto' uses slang, then Verilator, then Icarus Verilog — whichever is on PATH. slang gives full semantic errors (undeclared names, unknown types/members/ports) using the project's files.f.

tenxDebug.uvmLint.enable.description: UVM lint rules with quick fixes (factory registration, constructors, super.build_phase, objections, unchecked randomize()/config_db get, new() vs create). Waive a finding with // 10x-waive <RULE>.

tenxDebug.inlayHints.enable.description: Show port / parameter names on positional connections.

tenxDebug.format.collapseBlankLines.description: Formatter: collapse runs of blank lines to one (indentation and trailing blanks are always fixed).

tenxDebug.logs.links.description: Make file(line), file:line and uvm_test_top.* paths in logs, transcripts and terminals clickable.

tenxDebug.logs.maxFileSizeMB.description: Skip link detection for larger logs.

tenxDebug.dv.simulator.description: Default simulator for the DV flow (lightweight testbenches run on Icarus; UVM needs Questa or VCS).

enumDescriptions: Use locally installed open-source tools when present, the container image otherwise
Always run Icarus / Verilator / GHDL / Yosys / SymbiYosys from the container image
tenxDebug.toolchain.mode.description: Where the open-source tools (Icarus, Verilator, GHDL, Yosys, SymbiYosys, cocotb) come from. Commercial simulators (Questa, VCS) always run locally.

tenxDebug.toolchain.image.description: Leave empty (recommended): the extension uses its matching published image (ghcr.io/engineerwaseem121-dot/eda-tools:<version>), downloads it on the first run that needs it, and moves to newer compatible versions only after they pass a smoke test. Set an explicit image (e.g. a private registry mirror) to pin it.

tenxDebug.toolchain.autoUpdate.description: Check once a day for a newer compatible tools image and download it in the background. It is used only after its smoke test passes; the previous image stays as a fallback. Off: you are told about updates and run "Update Simulation Tools" yourself.

enumDescriptions: Docker on PATH, then Docker inside WSL (Windows), then Podman
Docker Engine inside WSL (Windows without Docker Desktop)
tenxDebug.toolchain.engine.description: Container engine for the open-source toolchain.

tenxDebug.toolchain.wslDistro.description: WSL distribution that runs Docker (empty = the default distribution).

tenxDebug.toolchain.mounts.description: Extra host folders to mount into the toolchain container (workspace folders, the temp folder and ~/.dvflow are always mounted).

tenxDebug.dv.icarusBin.description: Absolute folder containing iverilog/vvp (empty = PATH, C:\iverilog\bin, /usr/bin).

tenxDebug.dv.vcsBin.description: Absolute folder containing vcs (empty = PATH / VCS_HOME).

tenxDebug.dv.timeoutSeconds.description: Wall-clock timeout per simulation; the partial log is kept and the run is classified TIMEOUT.

tenxDebug.dv.ai.enable.description: Opt-in AI assistance (draft scenarios, summarize failures). Off by default; every request asks before sending, and only the shown text is sent.

tenxDebug.regression.parallel.description: Simulations run in parallel during a regression (needs one license per job).

color.description: Default trace color (#rrggbb). Empty = theme palette.

fill.description: Fill opacity under traces (0 disables fill).

renderer.description: line/bus = digital; step/linear = analog plot of the numeric value.

strokeWidth.description: Trace line width in px (multiples of 0.5).

tenxDebug.wave.display.defaultTraceStyle.markdownDescription: Default style of new traces in the waveform viewer. Per-signal color, renderer, stroke and fill can be changed from the signal's right-click menu.

tenxDebug.wave.display.disableGpu.description: Do not request GPU-accelerated canvas rendering (use if traces flicker on remote / VM displays).

tenxDebug.wave.keyboard.addSignal.description: Key that focuses the signal filter to add signals (e.g. 'a', 'ctrl+k').

tenxDebug.wave.keyboard.reload.description: Key that reloads the waveform from disk.

tenxDebug.wave.keyboard.zoomAmount.description: Zoom factor per zoom-in / zoom-out key press.

tenxDebug.wave.keyboard.zoomStart.description: Key that jumps the view to the start of the simulation.

tenxDebug.wave.keyboard.zoomEnd.description: Key that jumps the view to the end of the simulation.

tenxDebug.wave.keyboard.zoomFit.description: Key that zooms to fit the whole simulation.

tenxDebug.wave.keyboard.zoomTarget.description: Keyboard zoom keeps this point fixed (cursor falls back to center when off-screen).

tenxDebug.wave.mouse.reverseScrolling.description: Reverse the direction of horizontal panning and Ctrl+wheel zoom.

tenxDebug.wave.mouse.zoomTarget.description: Ctrl+wheel zoom keeps this point fixed.

tenxDebug.wave.theme.palette.description: Trace color palette (first = 1-bit default, second = bus default; all are offered in the signal color menu).

tenxDebug.wave.theme.minContrast.description: Contrast floor for trace colours against the editor background (WCAG ratio; 3 = WCAG non-text minimum, 4.5 = text). Colours below it are lightened/darkened automatically, so light and high-contrast themes stay readable. 0 disables.

tenxDebug.wave.crossProbe.followWaveform.description: When on, selecting a signal in a waveform tab reveals its declaration in the RTL (without taking focus). Ambiguous names (declared in several modules that the scope cannot disambiguate) are not followed. Off by default: right-click a signal → Go to declaration in RTL instead.

tenxDebug.wave.maxFileMB.description: Largest VCD the viewer loads (MiB). Files are read in 4 MiB chunks; larger dumps get an explanatory error instead of exhausting memory.

tenxDebug.wave.inlineValues.description: Show the value of each declared signal at the waveform cursor inline in open Verilog/SystemVerilog/VHDL editors.

tenxDebug.wave.logTimeUnit.description: Unit assumed for log timestamps without a unit (e.g. UVM '@ 120:').

tenxDebug.wave.converters.markdownDescription: Commands that convert non-VCD dumps to VCD. `{in}`/`{out}` are replaced. Defaults: `fst: fst2vcd -f "{in}" -o "{out}"`, `lxt2`/`lxt: lxt2vcd "{in}" -o "{out}"` (GTKWave tools). GHW has no default — set e.g. `"ghw": "mytool {in} {out}"` or dump VCD/FST from GHDL.

tenxDebug.lint.waiversFile.description: Workspace-relative lint waiver file (JSON: rule, file glob, match text or line, reason, owner, expires). Inline alternative: // tenx-lint-waive RULE: reason.

tenxDebug.netlist.yosysPath.description: yosys executable used by 'Schematic: Synthesize with Yosys and Show'.

tenxDebug.lint.onSave.description: Run the linter when a Verilog/SystemVerilog file is saved.

tenxDebug.lint.extraArgs.description: Extra arguments passed to the linter (e.g. include dirs: -Irtl/include).

tenxDebug.fsm.codeLens.description: Show an 'FSM' CodeLens above detected state machines.

tenxDebug.fsm.diagnostics.description: Report FSM issues (unreachable / unhandled / dead-end states, duplicate encodings).

tenxDebug.questa.path.markdownDescription: Questa / ModelSim **bin** folder (or install root). Examples: `C:\questasim64_2024.1\win64`, `C:\intelFPGA\23.1std\questa_fse\win64`, `/opt/questasim/linux_x86_64`, `~/intelFPGA_lite/23.1std/questa_fse/bin`. Leave empty to auto-detect (PATH, `QUESTA_HOME`, common install folders).

tenxDebug.questa.reportArgs.markdownDescription: Arguments passed to `vcover report` when opening a `.ucdb` (output file and UCDB are appended).

tenxDebug.coverage.goal.description: Coverage goal (%) used for status colours and analysis.

tenxDebug.coverage.openAfterRun.description: Open the coverage dashboard automatically after a Questa batch run.
